notes: One sample per case and mode.
Input sizes are Unicode characters, not tokens.
The benchmark does not record API token usage or generated proof text.
Helper visibility measures prompt inclusion, not use in the generated proof.
Saved fixtures use false for the benchmark flag so opening them makes no API calls; the measured runs used true. This flag is at the hole and is excluded from the model prompt.
One attempt per case and policy, no repair or reruns. Policy order: full, window, all_files, structured.
all_files_scope: Complete source of every transitively imported project module, once per module in Lean module order; dependency packages and LLMlean implementation excluded, as in structured mode. Includes Tests.ContextBench benchmark harness.
input_characters: total_input_chars counts Unicode characters in the user input plus fixed system instructions. input_chars records the user input alone. Neither includes HTTP/JSON framing.
